DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Erythema Toxicum

Based on the history of a generalized erythematous maculopapular rash with pustules, sparing of the palms and soles, and normal vital signs, this clinical picture is most consistent with Neonatal Erythema Toxicum. This is a benign, self-limiting condition commonly seen in healthy newborns.
